findings.verbatim: These approval/status strings use मंज़ूरी / मंज़ूर rather than the glossary/style-guide स्वीकृति / स्वीकृत family. The existing Approve button is स्वीकृति दें and Approved is स्वीकृत. Meaning remains approval, so this is terminology drift, not a changed security consequence. In file_key_disclosure the feminine मंज़ूरी also pairs awkwardly with दिया rather than दी.
findings.recommendation: Use the established स्वीकृति / स्वीकृत terminology and adjust gender agreement naturally in the disclosure.
findings.disposition: not applied: collected for the implementer’s unified remediation; target catalogue bytes are unchanged. Nonblocking terminology/typography finding; no consent consequence is reversed or omitted.
